2. Facts in short are that the plaintiff is the owner of the suit land and that he sold the suit land to defdt. No. 1 for a consideration of Tk. 2,000/- by a registered sale deed dated 28-1-1969 corresponding to 11th Magh, 1375 B.S., and that the defdt No. 1 on the same date executed an agreement in favour of the plff to reconvey the suit land if the puff returned the consideration money within Polish, 1380 B.S. corresponding to 14-1-1974. The plff. thereafter in pursuance of the provisions of P.O. No. 88 of 1972 filed on 29-1-1973 a Miscellaneous Case No. 189 of 1973-74 in the Court of the S.D.O., Sadar South, Comilla for restoration of the land from the defdt. No. 1. The S.D.O. passed an order of restoration of the land in favour of the plff. on 10-5-1974 and that as per order of the S.D.O., the plff. deposited the proportionate amount of Tk. 486.59 on 15-7-1974. Thereafter, the defdt No. 1 filed a suit being Title Suit No. 363 of 1974 in the Court of Munsif at Sadar, Comilla challenging the order of the S.D.O. In the meantime the plaintiff instituted this suit for reconveyance of the land as he was so entitled on the basis of the agreement of reconveyance. 

 3. Defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing a written statement. The case of the defdt No. 1 is that the suit is barred by limitation and that the plff. did not return the consideration money nor filed any suit 'Within' 'the stipulated period as mentioned in the deed of agreement. After the expiry of the period stipulated in the agreement the defdt. has got absolute right in the suit land. Hence, the plff is not entitled to get any reconveyance of the suit land as prayed for. 

 11. The decision referred to by the learned Advocate for the appellant in A.I.R. 1939 Nagpur-141, AIR-1926 Alahabad-345 and AIR 1939 (PC) 128 are not applicable in the facts of the present case.
